summary: Full backend + frontend E2E verification for Architect 2.0 Phase 1. 18/18 pytest backend tests passed. Frontend: cookie injection via page.context.add_cookies() DOES attach the httpOnly session_token to axios withCredentials requests (in-page /api/auth/me returned 200). All critical UI flows verified: landing, login/signup, protected-route redirect, custom 404, home hero prompt creates project & persists, projects page tabs, command palette (Ctrl+K), settings mode toggle persists to backend, onboarding redirect for onboarding_completed=false, project card delete flow (with confirm dialog), user menu logout returns to /login.

issues: Radix DialogContent warning in console: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}'. Minor a11y warning — add DialogDescription or aria-describedby to rename-dialog and delete-confirm dialog.

action_items: (Optional a11y) Add DialogDescription to ProjectCard rename & delete dialogs to silence Radix warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_current_user cleanly reads Bearer OR cookie — verified via tests.
All Mongo queries use projection {"_id": 0} — no ObjectId leaks.
User-scoped queries include user_id filter on every project op — cross-user isolation confirmed (all 404).
load-sample idempotency: deletes existing is_sample=True docs then re-inserts 4 — verified.
Frontend axios uses withCredentials=true and REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from env — correct.
Rename dialog and delete-confirm dialog missing accessible description (minor a11y).
test_credentials: Seeded Mongo directly: session tokens 'test_session_seed_01' (user_testseed01, onboarding_completed=true), 'test_session_seed_02' (user_testseed02, isolation test), 'test_session_seed_03' (user_onboard03, onboarding_completed=false). Backend accepts Bearer OR httpOnly cookie 'session_token'.
seed_data_creation: 3 users + 3 sessions seeded via mongosh. Also created several sample projects for user_testseed01 (via test flows and load-sample).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Cookie injection via Playwright add_cookies with domain=vibe-ship.preview.emergentagent.com, path=/, httpOnly=true, secure=true, sameSite='None' works correctly and the app's axios (withCredentials=true) sends the cookie. Bearer token 'test_session_seed_01' also works for direct API tests. To re-seed: run the mongosh snippet from /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Test session #3 may have been logged out during backend test_logout — re-seed if needed. Existing sample/test projects live under user_testseed01. Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, 18 tests, ~4s).
